title: Desktop first run: /login?onboard=1 draws the sign-in in the Setup frame; /login, the web and old users are unchanged
steps: S1: boot this checkout's tracy-web (memory store, console mail) on a free port.
S2: GET /login?onboard=1, /login, /login?onboard=0, /login?onboard=true and read the HTML.
S3: GET /signin/email with a good address, then with a malformed one and a foreign next.
S4: POST /auth/link/browser with an email on a desktop round, on a lane round, malformed, and over 254 characters.
expect: onboard=1: the Setup frame, four steps, step 1 current, steps 2-4 disabled, no Skip/Continue, the email form a GET to /signin/email and no sign-in script.
/login, onboard=0 and onboard=true: no Setup frame, the classic POST /login form with its script.
/signin/email: 302 to /login?email=<lowercased address>; a malformed address and a foreign next are dropped (302 /login); nothing is mailed.
A desktop round accepts an email (200); a lane round with one, a malformed one and one over 254 characters are refused (400).
fence: the onboard page is opt-in by exactly onboard=1 and carries no script; the email hint is desktop-only and validated
